rationale: The last three 1-minute candles printed higher highs and higher lows with closes on or near the highs of each bar, the most recent on 116k shares, showing demand stepping in above the 16.17 low. Price sits at only 9% of the daily range yet has closed the gap to the 9-EMA from 0.15 to 0.07 while SPY is positive and VIXY is lower, weakening the supply thesis that existed at entry. These mechanics favor exiting the short before a test of 16.30–16.34 materializes.
